title: EA is shutting down BioWare
why_read: Significant industry news about a storied game studio's closure, more about business and games industry trends than hard technical content.
analysis: EA shutting down BioWare, maker of Mass Effect and Dragon Age, is a notable games-industry event reflecting ongoing consolidation and economic pressure in AAA development. There's little direct engineering content here, it's primarily a corporate/business story, though it may prompt discussion of why certain technical and creative studios fail commercially. Technically literate readers interested in games may care, but it offers limited lasting technical insight.
